title: Outer Wilds
blurb: An amazing puzzle story game that is best enjoyed blind.
why: Some of the best puzzles I have ever experienced in gaming. Really rich story that all ties back into itself. Best game I have ever played.

title: Mesmalie
blurb: A point and click adventure game about getting help with your magick.
why: I love this games writing and art, it's so charming and rich. Lots of passion was put into this game and it's apparent.

title: Iron Nest
blurb: A game about operating a heavy mechanized war machine with extremely detailed mechanics.
why: Indepth mechanics that felt amazing to control and pilot. Kept me glued for hours, constantly figuring out faster ways to do things.
